themes.description: Users reported a wide range of issues, including app crashes, poor UI/UX, difficulty installing, account hacking, and lack of customer support.
themes.business_impact: High probability of app uninstalls due to a perceived broken experience, leading to lost customers and damaged brand reputation.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Inadequate testing and validation of the app's features, leading to bugs and usability issues.
themes.action_plan:
• Conduct thorough testing
• Update the UI/UX to be more intuitive and user-friendly
• Implement proper customer support
• Address app crashes and other bugs through iterative code releases.

themes.description: Customers are experiencing difficulty in getting help from the app due to unresponsive or non-existent customer care services. They are unable to resolve issues via automated chat services or human support, which leads to frustration and a poor overall experience.
themes.business_impact: High risk of customer churn and loss of revenue due to a lack of effective support channels.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Our customer support infrastructure is under-resourced or inefficient, leading to inadequate support for critical issues.
themes.action_plan: • Update customer support infrastructure to include multiple support channels (e.g. phone, email, live chat) with adequate staffing and resources to handle high volume of requests. Implement AI-driven chatbots to route complex issues to human support agents and enhance user experience.
